text:
India's factory PMI just hit 56.0, a nine month high.

The HSBC Flash India Manufacturing PMI rose to 56.0 in November 2026, up from 54.7 in October. Any reading above 50 means growth. New orders grew at the fastest pace since June, and factories added staff at the fastest rate in seven months.

Why it matters for an owner:
• More orders means more raw material to buy on time.
• More work orders to plan without missing dispatch dates.
• More invoices to raise and follow up before dues pile up.

What to do: make it a weekly check, not a month end scramble. Look at items below reorder level, open orders, and who owes you money. If finding those three numbers takes more than a few minutes, the records are too spread out.
